lines: The app declares Nextcloud 31 as its lowest server, and the lowest server image is 33: the end-of-life majors below it are not installed.
Nextcloud 33.0.11 on PHP 8.5.13: the app needs the app of OCA\Files_External, which the test server does not have, and info.xml has no way to name it.
OCA\Files_External: no app of the App Store has an id that namespace stands for.
What it causes is not reported on its own:
install-request-failed: 1 request is answered with a server error once the app is enabled.
